Cancer Treatment for Cats and Dogs
Receiving a cancer diagnosis for one of your pets can be distressing. Like us, dogs and cats can get different types of cancer that need professional care. We at Davies Veterinary Specialists are here to help make sure your pets receive the best care and treatment possible after their diagnosis and have every opportunity to have happy lives since we recognise how difficult this time can be.
Our team of veterinary oncology experts is committed to offering the best cancer therapies for dogs and cats while making sure that you and your pet are supported throughout the process. We tailor cancer treatments for each dog and cat and treat them with the respect they deserve.
Contact Us For a Referral
Understanding Cancer in Cats & Dogs
Pets often develop cancer, especially as they get older. It happens when abnormal cells begin multiplying out of control, which can impact the blood and lymphatic systems or lead to the formation of tumours. Like in people, cancer in dogs and cats can manifest in a variety of ways, such as:
Mast Cell Tumours
: A type of skin cancer that can affect cats but is more common in dogs.
Carcinomas
: These are cancers that start in the tissues that surround organs like the skin or lungs.
Lymphoma
: This type of cancer impacts the immune system’s lymphatic system.
Osteosarcoma
: A type of bone cancer that frequently affects larger dog breeds. It can be quite aggressive.
Soft Tissue Sarcomas
: Cancer develops in connective tissues including blood vessels, muscles, or fat.
Cancer can manifest in a variety of ways. Early detection is essential for receiving therapies that can significantly improve your pet’s prognosis and quality of life, regardless of the form it takes in your dogs or cats.
Signs of Cancer in Cats and Dogs
Like many other illnesses, cancer can manifest itself in a variety of ways, with symptoms varying based on the type of cancer and the body part impacted in your dog or cat. Here are a few typical symptoms and indicators to watch out for:
Weight loss or loss of appetite
sores that don’t seem to go away
Trouble breathing or a chronic cough
Lumps or swelling that don’t go away
Lethargy or lower energy levels
Vomiting or diarrhoea
Lameness or trouble walking
Consult your local veterinarian immediately then ask for a referral to Davies Veterinary Specialists if you have observed a change in your dog’s or cat’s conduct or habits like the above. We are able to provide your cats and dogs with efficient, customised cancer treatments and early cancer diagnosis confirmation.

Comprehensive Cancer Treatments for Cats and Dogs
We at Davies Veterinary Specialists offer a variety of cancer treatments for dogs and cats that are personalised to each patient’s requirements. Our team of highly qualified veterinary oncologists, surgeons, and nurses collaborates closely to develop an individual treatment strategy for your pet, with the ultimate goal of achieving optimal health.
Davies Veterinary Specialists offers a variety of cancer treatments for both dogs and cats, including:
Surgery
This is frequently the initial stage of cancer treatment, especially if a tumour can be safely removed. From removing minor tumours to more complicated treatments like limb-sparing for bone malignancies, our highly qualified surgeons can perform both small and complex surgical procedures.
To increase the likelihood of a positive outcome, surgery can be performed in conjunction with other cancer treatments for dogs and cats, such as chemotherapy.
Chemotherapy
Chemotherapy is the process of using medications to find and destroy cancerous cells. Outpatient chemotherapy clinics are available at Davies Veterinary Specialists in our chemotherapy suite, where your dogs and cats can have chemotherapy in a comfortable setting.
To stop cancer from spreading or to shrink tumours, this can be used alone or in conjunction with other treatments like surgery. Your pet may experience side effects, but our veterinary team is here to make sure your pet has as little suffering as possible during treatment.
Radiotherapy
Although we do not provide radiotherapy at Davies Veterinary Specialists, we do collaborate with radiotherapy facilities throughout the United Kingdom and refer patients who would benefit from this treatment. Every patient who is referred will have prompt access to therapy if necessary, and they are still welcome to visit us for additional treatments if necessary.
Palliative Care
Although cancer is sometimes non-treatable there are treatments that can help your pet feel less discomfort and live a better life. Cave Veterinary Specialists’ palliative care services are intended to make your dogs feel at ease.
When possible, we use a variety of supportive therapies, dietary management, and pain reduction techniques to assist your dogs and cats. In order to strengthen bones and control elevated blood calcium levels, we can also provide therapies such as bisphosphonates.
When it comes to cancer therapies for dogs and cats, Cave Veterinary Specialists provides a variety of alternatives that can be customised to meet your pet’s needs.

Why Davies Veterinary Specialists for Cancer Treatments for Cats and Dogs?
When your pet is diagnosed with cancer, it’s critical to have a caring and knowledgeable staff by your side to support them and you during their journey. We provide the best care and services for small pets at Davies Veterinary Specialists. We provide the following services to anyone in need of cancer treatments for cats and dogs:
A qualified oncology team
: A variety of cancers in cats and dogs can be diagnosed and treated by our in-house oncology staff with great experience. To provide thorough and efficient care for every creature in our care, we collaborate closely with our other internal teams.
Advanced diagnostic tools
: Success in treating cancer in dogs and cats requires an accurate diagnosis. Our cutting-edge diagnostic facilities guarantee that we can provide the right diagnosis along with efficient therapies that maximise your pet’s chances of recovery.
A collaborative approach to care
: To guarantee that your pet receives a collaborative approach to cancer treatment, we partner with your primary care veterinarians as a multidisciplinary in-house team.
Tailored treatments and care
: We treat every pet differently because they are each unique. Our staff takes the time to learn about your pet, hear your concerns, and create a thorough treatment plan tailored to your pet’s need.
Support Your Pet Through Their Cancer Treatment
Although receiving a cancer diagnosis might be extremely stressful, it’s crucial to remember that you are not alone. Our staff of veterinary specialists at Davies Veterinary Specialists is available to offer expert treatment, reassurance, and emotional support during your pet’s cancer journey. Whether it is through palliative care or curative treatments, our aim is to enhance your pet’s quality of life.
Get the best cancer treatments for dogs and cats by requesting a referral to Davies Veterinary Specialists in Hertfordshire right now.
